prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「小说」？
explanation: fiction 的意思是小说。

prompt: 「android」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: android 的意思是仿生人。

prompt: 选择表示「克隆体」的单词。
explanation: 表示克隆体的单词是 clone。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「外星人」？
explanation: alien 的意思是外星人。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「宇宙飞船」？
explanation: spacecraft 的意思是宇宙飞船。

prompt: 「gravity」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: gravity 的意思是重力。

prompt: 选择表示「维度」的单词。
explanation: 表示维度的单词是 dimension。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「实验」？
explanation: experiment 的意思是实验。

prompt: The android needs ___ before the next flight. 表示需要被检查，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: needs 后面用 to be checked，表示仿生人需要被检查。

prompt: 哪一句里 written 作定语？

choices.text: The fiction written last year is still popular
The fiction writing last year is still popular
Written the fiction last year is popular
The fiction to writing last year is popular

explanation: written last year 修饰 fiction，表示这本小说是去年被写的。
verify: "The fiction written last year is still popular"

prompt: She remembers ___ the spacecraft door. 表示记得已经关上，横线处填哪一个？

choices.text: closed it yesterday as a finite verb

explanation: remember doing 表示记得做过。remember to do 表示记得要去做。

prompt: 表示很高兴被邀请上船，哪一句正确？

choices.text: I am glad to inviting aboard
I am glad inviting aboard as the whole predicate
I am glad to be invited aboard
I am glad be invited aboard

explanation: glad 后面用 to be invited，是不定式的被动式。
verify: "I am glad to be invited aboard"

prompt: ___ the experiment, the crew left the lab. 实验已经做完，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: crew 自己做完实验，用 Having finished。

prompt: The clone, ___ in secret for years, was finally found. 多年来一直被藏着，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: clone 是被藏的，而且发生在 was found 之前，用 having been hidden。

prompt: 哪一句表示门正在被修？

choices.text: The door having repaired cannot be used
The door to repairing cannot be used
The door being repaired cannot be used
Repairing the door cannot be used as if the door repairs itself

explanation: being repaired 表示正在被修理。
verify: "The door being repaired cannot be used"

prompt: Having been tested twice 和 being tested 的差别是什么？

choices.text: 两者都表示将来主动去做
前者是疑问句，后者是虚拟语气
前者是已经被检测过，后者是正在被检测

explanation: having been tested 是完成被动，being tested 是进行被动。
verify: "前者是已经被检测过，后者是正在被检测"

prompt: 想说仿生人需要先被检查，哪一句合适？

choices.text: The android needs to checking first
The android needs to be checked first

explanation: needs to be checked 表示需要被检查。
verify: "The android needs to be checked first"

prompt: 想说做完实验后船员离开了，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Having been finished the experiment, the crew left
The experiment having the crew left
Having finished the experiment, the crew left

explanation: 船员是动作发出者，用 Having finished。
verify: "Having finished the experiment, the crew left"

prompt: 想说这本去年写的小说仍受欢迎，哪一句合适？

choices.text: The fiction writing last year is still popular
Written is the fiction popular last
The fiction to writing is popular
The fiction written last year is still popular

explanation: written last year 作定语。
verify: "The fiction written last year is still popular"

prompt: 想提醒对方记得去关舱门，事情还没做，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Please remember to close the spacecraft door
Please remember closing the spacecraft door yesterday

explanation: 还没做，用 remember to close。已经做过才用 remember closing。
verify: "Please remember to close the spacecraft door"

prompt: The fiction written in 2019 follows an android. Having finished a gravity experiment, the crew found the clone hidden in the lab. The spacecraft door being repaired cannot open yet. 这本小说写于哪一年？

choices.text: 船员出发那年没有写出

explanation: written in 2019 说明写于 2019 年。

prompt: The fiction written in 2019 follows an android. Having finished a gravity experiment, the crew found the clone hidden in the lab. The spacecraft door being repaired cannot open yet. 船员在发现克隆体之前做了什么？
explanation: Having finished a gravity experiment 发生在 found 之前。

prompt: The fiction written in 2019 follows an android. Having finished a gravity experiment, the crew found the clone hidden in the lab. The spacecraft door being repaired cannot open yet. 克隆体当时是什么状态？
explanation: the clone hidden in the lab。

prompt: The fiction written in 2019 follows an android. Having finished a gravity experiment, the crew found the clone hidden in the lab. The spacecraft door being repaired cannot open yet. 舱门为什么还不能开？
explanation: being repaired 表示正在被修理。

prompt: 要点：2019 年写成的小说、船员做完重力实验、舱门正在被修理。哪一句三个要点都有？

choices.text: The fiction written in 2019 shows a crew having finished a gravity experiment, while the door is being repaired

explanation: 三个要点都要出现。
verify: "The fiction written in 2019 shows a crew having finished a gravity experiment, while the door is being repaired"

prompt: 概要里表示克隆体被藏了很多年，哪一句正确？

choices.text: The clone, having been hidden for years, was found
The clone, having hidden for years, was found as if it hid itself
The clone being hide was found

explanation: clone 是被藏的，用 having been hidden。
verify: "The clone, having been hidden for years, was found"

prompt: 哪一句适合作为概要的第一句？

choices.text: This science fiction follow an android on a spacecraft
This science fiction follows an android on a spacecraft
This science fiction follows an android on an spacecraft
This science fiction follows a android on a spacecraft

explanation: 概要可以先点出人物和场景。
verify: "This science fiction follows an android on a spacecraft"

prompt: 表示记得已经关上门，哪一句正确？

choices.text: She remembers to close the door yesterday as a finished act

explanation: remembers closing 表示记得做过。
